name: Heat Pump Dryer
definition: A household tumble dryer that uses a closed-loop refrigerant heat-pump system to condition and recirculate drying air while collecting or draining condensed textile moisture.
includedScope: Compact and full-size ventless heat-pump dryers
excludedScope: Vented resistance dryers and non-heat-pump condenser dryers
Washer-dryer combos and commercial drying equipment
Unverified refrigerant, filter, stacking or cross-model parts
primaryApplications: Condensate collection or model-approved direct drainage
headline: Heat-pump dryer airflow, refrigerant loop and buyer checks
description: This profile separates rated load, closed-loop air and refrigerant architecture, condensation, energy test basis, ambient limits, lint and heat-exchanger care, stacking and service parts so buyers can compare exact heat-pump dryers without treating ventless as a complete specification.
metaDescription: Heat-pump dryer guide covering closed-loop airflow, capacity, energy tests, models, installation, maintenance and component checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, textile-care, refrigerant-service or installation advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, load, cycle, supply, condensate route, ambient limits, stacking kit, lint and heat-exchanger maintenance and service-part numbers before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Household tumble dryer with a closed-loop refrigerant heat-pump drying system
keyFacts.evidence: LG describes heat-pump drying as a closed-loop system; official models identify heat-pump or ventless heat-pump configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Household electric tumble dryers; non-heat-pump condenser and vented dryers excluded.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match load, test method, supply, condensate route, ambient limits, maintenance and stacking kit to the exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Official product and manual records show different capacity, voltage, drainage, maintenance and accessory configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Exact regional model and installation site.

systemFlow.name: Load and airflow
systemFlow.componentFamily: Door, drum, drive, fan, ducts and lint filtration
systemFlow.role: Turns the load and circulates process air through the textiles.
systemFlow.evidence: Official models publish front-load drums, ventless airflow and model-specific lint care.

systemFlow.name: Heat-pump loop
systemFlow.componentFamily: Evaporator, condenser, compressor, expansion device, refrigerant and heat-exchanger surfaces
systemFlow.role: Removes moisture from recirculated air and returns heat to the drying process.
systemFlow.evidence: LG defines the closed-loop principle and manufacturers identify heat-pump systems on exact models.
systemFlow.scope: Sealed-system architecture of the exact model.

systemFlow.name: Condensate and control
systemFlow.componentFamily: Water container or drain, pump where fitted, moisture and temperature sensors, controller and user interface
systemFlow.role: Routes condensed water and stops or adjusts the cycle according to the selected program.
systemFlow.evidence: Official documentation identifies model-specific containers, drainage and sensor programs.
systemFlow.scope: Exact installation, firmware and accessory arrangement.

variants.name: Compact heat-pump dryer
variants.operatorRelationship: User cleans declared filters and empties or connects condensate drainage
variants.spaceConstraints: Compact cabinet, door swing, service clearance and model-approved stacking
variants.limitations: Compact width does not establish load, cycle time or stack compatibility.
variants.evidence: Bosch and Miele publish compact ventless heat-pump formats.

variants.name: Full-size heat-pump dryer
variants.taskScale: Routine family laundry and larger source-declared loads
variants.operatorRelationship: User selects dryness and fabric program and performs lint/heat-exchanger care
variants.spaceConstraints: Cabinet depth, door clearance, electrical supply, condensate route and room temperature
variants.limitations: Nominal kg and cu ft values use regional conventions and cannot be directly converted.
variants.evidence: LG, Samsung, Beko and Haier publish full-size heat-pump configurations.

performanceMetrics.name: Rated drying capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Source-declared dry textile load under a named market method
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: kg and cu ft labels use different conventions
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not convert drum volume into textile mass or assume equal usable load.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official regional pages publish capacity in their market units.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact model and declared rating basis.

performanceMetrics.name: Energy use and efficiency
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Electrical demand for a defined test load and program
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Load, initial moisture, program, label jurisdiction and ambient conditions differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A promotional percentage or label class is not comparable without its reference dryer and method.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC 61121 defines performance methods; LG qualifies its comparison with an 8.45 lb DOE load at 57.5% initial moisture content.
performanceMetrics.scope: Named method and exact claim conditions.

performanceMetrics.name: Cycle time and final moisture
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Time and dryness achieved for a declared load and setting
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Sensor target, load composition, initial moisture, room temperature and maintenance state affect results
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Lower operating temperature does not by itself prove faster or more complete drying.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources describe sensor programs and model-specific low-temperature or rapid options.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Run matched loads and record time, final moisture, energy, lint care and room conditions.
applicationFit.assessment: Run matched loads and record time, final moisture, energy, lint care and room conditions.
applicationFit.basis: Heat-pump control, initial moisture, load and maintenance interact.
applicationFit.limitations: Capacity and efficiency labels do not predict every site result.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Witness representative cotton and mixed loads under documented programs.
applicationFit.evidence: IEC and official model sources define differing performance boundaries.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Verify supply, door, drainage, ambient range, service access and exact stacking kit.
applicationFit.assessment: Verify supply, door, drainage, ambient range, service access and exact stacking kit.
applicationFit.basis: Ventless operation still rejects some heat to the room and requires serviceable air and condensate paths.
applicationFit.limitations: Shared width or brand does not prove pairing or stacking approval.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Attach the installation drawing and exact washer, dryer and kit codes to the order.
applicationFit.evidence: Bosch, LG and Miele publish model-specific dimensions and accessories.

componentStack.name: Drum, drive and airflow system
componentStack.role: Tumbles textiles and moves recirculated air through the load.
variants: Model-specific fan, duct and lint-filter arrangement
criticalChecks: Drum, bearing and belt service boundary
componentStack.evidence: Official model documentation shows different drive, drum and filter configurations.
componentStack.scope: Exact serial family; no cross-model fit.

componentStack.name: Heat-pump sealed system
componentStack.role: Condenses moisture and recovers heat into the process air.
variants: Single or manufacturer-described inverter compressor systems
componentStack.evidence: LG identifies a Dual Inverter HeatPump and auto-cleaning condenser; other models publish their own heat-pump architecture and care.

componentStack.name: Condensate, sensing and control
componentStack.role: Collects or drains water and controls the dryness endpoint.
componentStack.evidence: Official product and support records define model-specific water and sensing arrangements.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Final moisture, time, energy and fabric result
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by energy class, kg or promotional saving alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Run matched loads under declared conditions.
procurementDecisions.basis: Initial moisture, program, ambient conditions and maintenance affect performance.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No single catalogue figure predicts every load.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Compare witnessed like-for-like loads and record the full test boundary.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and official manufacturer claims expose different methods and qualifications.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Supply, drainage, stacking, filters, heat exchanger and sealed-system support
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming ventless or shared cabinet width establishes fit
procurementDecisions.assessment: Price the exact installed system and five-year maintenance parts.
procurementDecisions.basis: Accessories, refrigerant circuits and service boundaries differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future parts and refrigerant support are not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain written stacking-kit, filter, pump, sensor and sealed-system service details.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific accessories and support.

engineeringChecks.reason: Heat-pump capacity and cycle control depend on approved room conditions, supply and water disposal.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Record room temperature range, outlet, clearance and drain route against the exact manual.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official model records publish different supply and condensate arrangements.

engineeringChecks.reason: Restricted airflow or incorrect sealed-system work can affect performance and safety.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Follow exact cleaning intervals and use qualified refrigerant service where required.
engineeringChecks.evidence: LG and Bosch describe model-specific condenser systems; manuals govern service.

standards.name: IEC 61121:2012
standards.applicability: Methods for measuring performance of household electric tumble dryers.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and the exact declared method.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-11:2024
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for household tumble dryers, including appliances using a refrigerating system.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the current tumble-dryer safety standard scope.
standards.scope: Confirm regional conformity and amendments for the exact product.
